name: rq3_detection_v2
description: RQ3 detection comparison: legacy local-median deviation vs global-median JS vs the proposed rolling-histogram JS + robust z + CUSUM detector. Clean sequences probe false positives.

detectors.description: intermediate: JS vs global median histogram, robust threshold + hysteresis
proposed: JS vs rolling median histogram, max(z_JS, z_luma), CUSUM, segment pruning

notes: All hist_kl thresholds are label-free (robust median/MAD of the score; CUSUM k/h are fixed signal-processing constants).
The legacy detector keeps the fixed 1.0 threshold used by the prior study.
CLEAN runs are evaluated by false-positive rate only.
Parameter sensitivity for the CUSUM detector is reported separately as an ablation.
